It made four reusable blocks (hero, rich text, image, quote) on one shared block grid, a front page with post cards (image, date, excerpt), and two posts. It followed the MCP-only channel and the required order of steps, and its final report was accurate.

1. The posts are short. *Composable websites: MCP meets the block grid* has only two paragraphs and one image.
2. Blog posts have no publish-date property, so the front-page cards show the last-updated date instead (`Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml`).
3. The front page has an `intro` property that is filled in but never shown. Its `title` only sets the browser tab title. Both repeat what the hero block already says.
